name: Gun Massacre
summary:
"Gun Massacre" is slow-paced Survival Horror which resembles the classics. Set inside a remote mansion left to you after your grandfather's mysterious death, you arrive to take a look around. Not long after, you find yourself locked inside with almost no way of defending yourself.

Use the environment to your advantage, sneak past enemies or unleash a massacre until you are left with no ammo. The choice is yours, but choosing wrong may lead to your demise.
